prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0024 追加と退出のアカウント操作グループ.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact two-row account action group, original region24,702,342,114 normalized. Exact only Japanese text: first 別のアカウントを追加; second ログアウト. Meiryo REGULAR40014px/24px,tracking0, ordinary bodyweight no bold. ORIGINAL controls both glyphs: first a small plus INSIDE a complete circle, slate#526173; second small X INSIDE a complete circle, red#C65F52. Second ログアウト label must also be red to preserve source destructive semantics, NOT mock's blacklabel/door-with-arrow glyph. Match source circle/plus/X geometry, common optical size/stroke, labelbaseline and compact spacing. Single white rounded card, subtle neutralborder/soft downwardshadow, fine inset divider betweenrows. Pure-white outercanvas, no gray/mint outerpanel. Preserve exactly two rows and no selection, no greenprimarybutton or extra icons. Uniformly enlarge342px logical width/114px height into readable wide1400x600 with restrainedmargin. No rest of account sheet, phone or other content.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Restore functional redlogout icon/label. Add-account utility staysslate onwhite; no additional accent or greenaction needed.
reviewNotes: 原版/crop/mock目視。丸plusと赤丸X/赤logoutを復元、mockのdoorarrowは不採用。生成後に2日本語label、2circleglyph、reddestructive意味、divider、whitecardを確認。追加accentなし。font同一性/操作/native編集/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
